gaps: No full Palau-specific climate→violence or reverse insecurity pathway is supported; water access, remoteness and heritage loss are vulnerabilities without automatically implying FCV.
The official 2025 water policy and detailed older site studies are combined only with their distinct vintages; old Melekeok project status is not current.

executive_assessment.text: The bank distinguishes Ngerikiil/Airai–Koror supply dependence, remote-atoll catchments, rural Babeldaob water-quality constraints and historical Melekeok/Kayangel cultural-site exposure.

Policy and reef-governance capacities include funding/integration constraints and locally designed strategies; planned training, future bleaching claims and proposed works are not delivered or observed outcomes.
